limitations: Text editions only: no images, video, audio or paywalls. No attachments or media: resources are not used.
Story groups are assigned by the fixture or edition.publish event author; there is no automatic clustering.
No live ingestion or external links; every edition is a synthetic record inside the App.
One reader account per App instance. The public catalog is copied into each instance, so Infra applies every edition.publish event to every reader instance in the run.
Search matches the start of words (case- and accent-insensitive); there is no ranking or stemming.
MCP only: no GUI and no reviewer console.
